title: 🔆🔅Strait of Hormuz — 17 October— A violating supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, which intended to pass through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz, struck a mine, resulting in an incident that led to an explosion and a severe fire.
text:
🔆🔅Strait of Hormuz — 17 October— A violating supertanker carrying more than 2 million barrels of crude oil, which intended to pass through an unauthorized route in the Strait of Hormuz, struck a mine, resulting in an incident that led to an explosion and a severe fire."

"Source: Pool, IRGC
